summary.text: Jay Hooper is a Democrat from Randolph who represents the Orange-Washington-Addison district in the Vermont House of Representatives.
He sits on the House Committee on Government Operations and Military Affairs.

paragraphs.text: Hooper was born in Berlin, Vermont, in 1993 and graduated from Connecticut College with a double major in history and government, according to his House biography.
He returned to his hometown of Brookfield and ran for the House.
He grew up in a family of cheese-makers who established Vermont Creamery in the early 1980s.
In his first term he served on the House Agriculture and Forestry Committee, and in his second and third terms he served on the House Education Committee.
In his fourth term he joined the Government Operations Committee, which his father chaired in the 1980s.
His biography says he hosts a Saturday radio show, The Heat of the House, on WCVR during the legislative session.
